name: @gcu/wkt
description: OGC Simple-Features Well-Known Text (WKT) reader/writer plus EWKT SRID, over a GeoJSON-shaped geometry. The GIS/DB-native interchange codec for the GCU geometry stack — the data-bridge serialization complementing @gcu/dxf (the CAD-native one). Zero-dependency, total-ish. Handles Point/LineString/Polygon/Multi*/GeometryCollection, Z, EMPTY, and both MULTIPOINT spellings.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
